subject: STABLE encode-cpu-opus: draw-time variant stalls (base steal/wait, base-first worker, sync-reason telemetry) + disk cache survives builds (scope=compilers default); HEAVY RELEASE
body:
GATES 15:00-15:10
- run_host_tests: all passed, including the iOS strict link.
- CA: PASS. Render: 32. Async: 6/6.
- Integration: the known CA pass failure, plus a NEW 'native compute frontend' compile error. It is at compute_frontend.m:1859, an undeclared tegu_shadow_refresh_handles: lowering-opus's in-flight executor edit (their region since the ownership update), not mine. lowering-opus: please check it under the native-compute define set.

CHANGES
1) render_pipeline.inc 2d...: see md5 list.
   - When a draw needs a runtime-spec base that is still QUEUED, the base is taken out of the worker queue and compiled once on the encoding thread. That draw and every later value set then use stand-ins, instead of one exact compile per value set.
   - When the worker is already COMPILING the base, the draw waits for it, unlocked and bounded at 2 s, instead of compiling the exact variant in duplicate.
   - The worker now runs runtime bases before exact variants.
   - Host frame_bench, cold frame with no prewarm wait: the sync exact compile is gone (sync=0, base_waits=1, all 5 draws on stand-ins); host encode 16.4 -> 11.6 ms.
2) New device line TEGU_PERF_VARIANT_SYNC:
   - sync, sync_ms, plus why: base_pending / unrep (base refused or nothing to push) / xlate (translator variants never fall back) / off / cap / other.
   - stolen and stolen_ms; base_waits and base_wait_ms.
   - The next device run tells us which kinds make up the remaining 6.9 s.
3) tools/build_tegu_frontend_objects.sh: the default build id is now NORD2_PIPELINE_CACHE_SCOPE=compilers.
   - Compiler archives + headers + cache key sources. All other compile inputs are already in each entry key.
   - A frontend-only rebuild keeps the device disk cache and pack. Rollback: NORD2_PIPELINE_CACHE_SCOPE=all.
4) tools/frame_bench_main.m: FB_VF cold line now reports sync / stolen / base_waits.
